en: The postcard displays a sepia-toned photograph of an early industrial facility with a large, cylindrical water tower and several brick and metal buildings. The text 'Ljungaverk, Kraftstationen.' appears at the top left of the image, indicating the subject is the power station in Ljungaverk. The reverse side contains handwritten correspondence in Swedish and is addressed to 'Fröken Hanna Walberg' at an address in Sundsvall, Sweden. A Swedish postage stamp is affixed.
